name: LiNKskills
description: Private Skills adapter for Lisa: structured telemetry outbox against Skills Gateway contracts. Default-disabled; never registers conversation hooks; fake-only until activation gates.

mcpDiscoveryRead.label: Skills MCP Discovery/Read
mcpDiscoveryRead.help: When false, no Skills discovery/retrieval tools are exposed; native OpenClaw skills continue.

governedExecution.label: Governed Execution
governedExecution.help: When false, block LiNKskills execution only; native skills continue.

telemetryEnqueue.label: Telemetry Enqueue
telemetryEnqueue.help: When false, no new Skills telemetry records are accepted; existing outbox is retained.

telemetryDrain.label: Telemetry Drain
telemetryDrain.help: When false, stop Skills delivery; local durable queue is retained.

skillsCredential.label: Skills Credential
skillsCredential.help: SecretRef or string for the Skills-only credential. Never paste live secrets into source.

redactionPolicyVersion.label: Redaction Policy Version
redactionPolicyVersion.help: Allowlist policy version applied to structured telemetry envelopes before remote writes.

outboxMaxEntries.label: Outbox Max Entries
outboxMaxEntries.help: Per-namespace keyed-store capacity with reject-new overflow.

skillsEndpoint.description: Optional Skills ingestion endpoint distinct from managed MCP. Fake-only until gates.
